name: Distributed KV store with failure injection
problem: Replicated key-value store with a failure-injection test suite (node kill, partition, slow disk) that checks linearizability on small histories.
limits: Three actual child processes hold in-memory replicas. Fixed coordinator serializes client operations; successful writes require two prepare acknowledgements. Tests physically kill one replica and inject transport partition/slow-replica acknowledgements. No leader election, coordinator crash recovery, disk durability, automatic repair, Byzantine tolerance or production consensus guarantee is claimed. Replicas prepare values before coordinator commit; the coordinator is the authoritative read path. Small completed histories are checked exhaustively against single-register semantics; failed operations are excluded because they do not update coordinator state. Checker complexity is factorial. The seeded stale-read history fails in evidence/gate-failure.log.
next: Add durable logs, repair, leader election and concurrent histories with timeouts/indeterminate operations.
